demos.title: Operate BGP from the live dashboard
demos.description: Connect to Ze over SSH, open the live BGP dashboard, sort peers, and inspect one session.

demos.title: Create ZeFS and commit over SSH
demos.description: Create the ZeFS database, edit the active configuration through Ze's SSH management plane, and verify the committed setting.

demos.title: Prove read-only RBAC enforcement
demos.description: Run an allowed NOC command, then show Ze explicitly refuse a known state-changing command.

demos.title: Trace a live path without external services
demos.description: Run Ze's live traceroute through a deterministic Linux network-namespace lab.
demos.privileged-reason: it builds its lab with ip netns add, whose bind mount under /run/netns Docker's default AppArmor profile refuses (deny mount) even with SYS_ADMIN granted, and writes net.ipv4.ip_forward in each namespace

demos.title: Discover Ze commands interactively
demos.description: Use type-ahead filtering and drill-down navigation in Ze's interactive command launcher.

demos.title: Edit and commit configuration in the browser
demos.description: Change a YANG-backed setting, review the generated diff, commit the draft, and verify the active value.

demos.title: Protect live SSH commits with rollback
demos.description: Load a risky hostname change over SSH, observe automatic rollback, then accept a second change and prove it persists on the same running router.
demos.privileged-reason: the shared showcase lab creates network namespaces and runs XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: Enable RPKI live and diagnose a cache outage
demos.description: Commit the RTR cache and validation binding live, distinguish Valid, NotFound and ineligible Invalid routes, diagnose a stopped cache, and restore synchronization.
demos.privileged-reason: the shared showcase lab creates network namespaces and runs XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: Add IRR filtering to an existing BGP peer
demos.description: Load the local test IRR server, AS-SET and import policy over SSH, prove route acceptance and refusal, then diagnose and repair a wrong AS-SET without restarting Ze.
demos.privileged-reason: the shared showcase lab creates network namespaces and runs XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: Follow a route from BGP RIB to Linux FIB
demos.description: Inject one route, inspect BGP best-path selection, and verify Linux installed it with Ze's route protocol ID. Validation also proves withdrawal removes it.

demos.title: Separate live warnings from recent errors
demos.description: Read aggregate component health, follow a live stale-prefix warning from the SSH banner into show warnings, then reset a peer and find the retained event in show errors.

demos.title: Render one configuration for humans and automation
demos.description: Show one BGP peer as hierarchical blocks and set commands, round-trip between both with identical canonical output, then compose match and count over Ze's plugin registry.

demos.title: Let BFD protect a live BGP session
demos.description: Commit BFD onto an established FRR BGP peer, cut the link, inspect diagnostics and peer history, then restore both sessions without restarting Ze.
demos.privileged-reason: the shared showcase lab creates network namespaces and runs XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: Enable OSPF and diagnose a Hello mismatch
demos.description: Commit OSPF live, follow a Full neighbor through the router database to its loopback route, then diagnose and repair mismatched Hello timers.
demos.privileged-reason: the shared showcase lab creates network namespaces and runs XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: Attribute a live traffic burst
demos.description: Enable eBPF accounting on the running router, attribute an unexpected ICMP and HTTP burst to its source and port, stop the sender, and observe recovery.
demos.privileged-reason: the shared showcase lab creates network namespaces and runs XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: Track an uplink and fail over without stopping Ze
demos.description: Commit VRRP and uplink tracking live, observe priority reduction and backup demotion, then prove master failover and recovery while the shown Ze stays running.
demos.privileged-reason: the shared showcase lab creates network namespaces and runs XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: Build and repair a native IPsec tunnel live
demos.description: Commit IKE, ESP, selectors and XFRM routing over SSH, prove kernel SPIs with protected traffic, diagnose an ESP mismatch, and restore the tunnel.
demos.privileged-reason: the shared showcase lab creates network namespaces and runs XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: One running router, eight live configuration topics
demos.description: Migrate ExaBGP, operate the BGP dashboard, then configure, prove, diagnose and repair eight features in one continuous session without restarting Ze.
demos.privileged-reason: the continuous showcase creates network namespaces and runs real XFRM, VRRP and eBPF fixtures, which require namespace mounts and kernel access beyond Docker's default profile

demos.title: Inspect a Linux host before Ze starts
demos.description: Use Ze's offline command fallback to read the complete kernel, CPU, and memory inventory in human-readable structured output.

demos.title: Find every peer affected by a group change
demos.description: Inspect and validate a BGP group, then use Ze's dependency graph to prove which peers inherit the value before scheduling maintenance.
